cards.caption_en: A rod beside the river, a fish in the net, and sand beneath my feet.
cards.caption_zh: 河边一根钓竿，网中一条鱼，脚下是一片沙地。

River on right with dark deeper-looking channel and visible near sandy land. Large landing net rests on damp sand at lower right containing one clearly visible silvery fish, realistic head fins and tail. words.example: I sit by the river.
words.evidence: 实际河道水面。

words.example: A fish rests in the net.
words.evidence: 网中实际可辨鱼体。

words.example: I hold a fishing rod.
words.evidence: 完整细长钓竿。

words.example: The hook is on the tray.
words.evidence: 托盘中实际弯曲金属钩。

words.example: The net holds a fish.
words.evidence: 网圈与网袋实际区域。

words.example: The net lies on wet sand.
words.evidence: 河岸细沙区域。

words.example: The river is deep beyond the sandy bank.
words.evidence: 定位句子所指河水区域，实际水深由故事说明，不用颜色测深。

words.example: My feet stay on dry land.
words.translation: 我的双脚留在干燥的陆地上。
words.evidence: 与河水分开的实际岸地。

cards.caption_en: The sky changes; mist covers the hills, and I hear thunder.
cards.caption_zh: 天空变了；薄雾笼罩山丘，我听见了雷声。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One 4:5 portrait English scene-card base photo, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial, adult East Asian woman about 25, elegant ivory/slate clothing, loose low bun, delicate natural makeup, genuine skin texture, natural hands. Cool pearl daylight, true greens, real materials, crisp teaching objects, restrained composition and clean spaces near edges for later labels. NO text, letters, digits, brands, labels, watermark, app UI. Two equal vertically stacked photos at the same hill viewpoint, same adult woman. Upper: pale blue sky, a few white clouds, distant crisp green hills, woman calmly looking out. Lower: the same viewpoint now under grey storm clouds, visible low mist on distant hills and fine rain; woman under a plain umbrella at side, looking toward clouds. Clearly distinguish clouds overhead from mist close to hills. Lightning or sound symbols are not needed. No captions.

words.example: The sky is blue before the rain.
words.evidence: 上幅天空实际区域。

words.example: A white cloud crosses the sky.
words.evidence: 上幅独立白云。

words.example: Mist covers the distant hills.
words.evidence: 下幅贴近山丘的真实雾层。

words.example: The weather changes while I wait.
words.evidence: 晴雨两幅提供线索，天气变化由完整句子说明。

words.example: I hear thunder beyond the hills.
words.translation: 我听见山丘那边传来雷声。
words.evidence: 声音不能静态定位，不把云或闪电当雷声。

words.example: A sudden change in the weather surprises me.
words.translation: 天气突然变化让我吃了一惊。
words.evidence: 变化速度来自故事，静态对比不能证明突然。

words.example: I breathe the fresh air.
words.evidence: 空气不可见，雾不当空气本体。

cards.caption_en: Spring flowers, summer shade, winter snow: the same park through the seasons.
cards.caption_zh: 春花、夏荫、冬雪：同一座公园里的季节流转。

words.example: Flowers open in spring.
words.evidence: 定位故事所指春季上幅，季节由句子设定而非单凭花鉴定。

words.example: The park is green in summer.
words.evidence: 定位故事所指夏季中幅。

words.example: Snow covers the path in winter.
words.evidence: 定位故事所指冬季下幅。

words.example: Fresh snow lies beside the pond.
words.evidence: 下幅实际积雪，区别于平滑冰面。

words.example: A layer of ice covers the pond.
words.evidence: 下幅池塘实际平滑冰面。

words.example: It is a cold day in the park.
words.evidence: 温度由句子说明，衣着和雪仅提供线索。

cards.caption_en: A ray of light reaches the path; I pause in the shade to enjoy the view.
cards.caption_zh: 一束光照向小径；我停在树荫里，欣赏眼前的景色。

words.example: A ray of light reaches the path.
words.evidence: 实际可见穿过薄雾的光束。

words.example: I rest in the shade of a tree.
words.evidence: 树下实际较暗的地面区域。

words.example: I enjoy the mountain view.
words.evidence: 实际远处山湖全景。

words.example: I think the view is beautiful.
words.evidence: 个人审美判断由句子表达，不是可测物体属性。

words.example: I have a clear view of the mountains.
words.evidence: 定位句子指代的可辨山景，不表示空气质量检测。

words.example: This is a great place to rest.
words.evidence: great选评价义，个人评价由原创句子说明。

cards.caption_en: A globe, a map, and a flag help me talk about the world.
cards.caption_zh: 一个地球仪、一张地图和一面旗帜，帮我聊起这个世界。
cards.image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One 4:5 portrait English scene-card base photo, refined cool Korean Instagram editorial, adult East Asian woman about 25, elegant ivory/slate clothing, loose low bun, delicate natural makeup, genuine skin texture, natural hands. Cool pearl daylight, true greens, real materials, crisp teaching objects, restrained composition and clean spaces near edges for later labels. NO text, letters, digits, brands, labels, watermark, app UI. Travel editorial at quiet scenic outdoor lookout table: woman at side studying a large blank-paper simplified world map with clear coastlines and ONE highlighted blue country-sized land region, realistic globe with blue oceans and green continents on desk, simple compass without any letters or digits, small plain blue fabric flag on stand. All three globe map and flag sufficiently large and distinct, readable objects not blurred. Direction identity will be explained by sentences, no arrows, cardinal letters, country names, political slogans or fake writing. Neutral globe continents, no emphasis on disputed boundaries.

words.example: The hills are to the north of this table.
words.translation: 山丘在这张桌子的北方。
words.evidence: 方位由故事设定，不能从无字指南针或画面上下推断真实北方。

words.example: The village is to the south.
words.evidence: 故事给出地理方位，静态图不证明。

words.example: The sun rises in the east.
words.evidence: 自然例句说明方位，不将照片太阳位置当指南针读数。

words.example: The sun sets in the west.
words.evidence: 例句给出方位知识，不框虚假西方区域。

words.example: The globe is a model of the earth.
words.evidence: 定位地球仪这个地球模型，区别本体与模型。

words.example: This blue area on the map represents my country.
words.translation: 地图上的这块蓝色区域代表我的国家。
words.evidence: 定位明确高亮的地图指代区域，国家身份由故事说明。

words.example: The people of this nation share a history.
words.translation: 这个民族的人们有着共同的历史。
words.evidence: 共同历史的群体由句子说明，不用旗帜或单个人替代民族。

words.example: A blue flag stands beside the globe.
words.translation: 一面蓝色旗帜立在地球仪旁。
words.evidence: 实际纯蓝布旗，不当任何国家身份鉴定。

lexical_review: Codex按本卡词义、词性与例句编辑复核，未声称访问词典全文。
